title: Users
description: Accounts that can sign in with email and password
searchPlaceholder: Search by email or user ID

empty.title: No accounts yet
empty.description: Create the first account, or run: goclaw user create --email you@example.com --generate

create.title: Create account
create.description: The person signs in with this email and password.
create.userIdHint: Set a user ID to attach this account to agents, sessions or tenant membership that already belong to that identity.
create.noTenantWarning: Without tenant membership the account signs in as a viewer and cannot use the dashboard.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: {{email}} will no longer be able to sign in. Their sessions end immediately.

setPassword.title: Set password
setPassword.hint: All their sessions end and they must change it on next sign-in.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.description: Update the password for your account.
changePassword.forcedDescription: An administrator set your current password. Choose a new one to continue.
changePassword.success: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
